Senses.Explanation: To leak out or show through. Chan records most often use the expression as a retrospective appraisal after someone has spoken or acted: 'it leaked out,' 'quite a lot leaked out,' 'the whole body leaked out,' or 'one could not avoid leaking once.' Foyan applies the same verdict in succession to Deshan's statement that his house has no phrases and no single thing to give people, Xuefeng's statement that he went empty-handed and returned empty-handed, and Muzhou's calling a monk a board-carrying fellow. The Blue Cliff Record says that much had leaked out when Bodhidharma pressed Emperor Wu at the outset. A later direct question, 'What is the place of leaking out?' receives a list of recorded expressions and objects: Yunmen's flatbread, Zhaozhou's tea, Xuefeng's wooden ball, and Zihu's dog. The records do not identify a single substance that leaks, and this entry adds none.
Senses.Note: The corpus has 488 matches in 172 files. 'It leaked out' occurs sixty times in thirty-seven files; 'quite a lot leaked out' occurs eighty-one times in fifty-four; 'the whole body leaked out' occurs twice in two; and 'could not avoid leaking out' occurs twice in two. One passage in one file directly asks where leaking out is. The two nominal-looking matches ending in 'one who leaks' are parts of late verse lines about a portrait or a festival wrapper and do not supply a separate definition.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問德山：如何是宗門奇特事？山曰：我宗無語句，實無一法與人。師曰：漏逗了也。僧問雪峰：和尚見德山，得個什麼便歸來？峰曰：我當時空手去，空手回。師曰：漏逗了也。睦州喚僧，僧回頭。州曰：擔板漢。師曰：漏逗了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷): complete-case exact-turn review identifies Foyan Qingyuan as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 達磨劈頭與他一拶。多少漏逗了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Yuanwu Keqin as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 德山道：『我宗無語句，亦無一法與人。』全身漏逗了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuan'an Feng (遠菴僼禪師語錄), in Yuan'an Feng's hall address. Yuan'an Feng is the exact speaker of the appraisal 'the whole body leaked out' immediately after quoting Deshan Xuanjian's claim that his lineage has no phrases and no teaching to give people. Deshan speaks only the embedded quotation; the headword occurs in Yuan'an's following comment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 今日乃建州眾道友以鄉情之舊來為老僧慶壽，請上堂，不免漏逗一場。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian (永覺元賢禪師廣錄). At his birthday address requested by old friends from Jianzhou, Yongjue Yuanxian says, 'Today I cannot avoid leaking out once.'

Occurrences.Kwic: 且道如何是漏逗處？良久，曰：雲門餬餅趙州茶，雪峰木毬紫湖狗。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)): in Tianzhang Yu's explicitly headed section, Tianzhang Yu asks where the leak is and, after pausing, answers with Yunmen's cake, Zhaozhou's tea, Xuefeng's wooden ball, and Zihu's dog.

Occurrences.Kwic: 釋迦老子半夜逾城，直往雪山，早是漏逗不少，更思惟箇什麼？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continued Essentials of the Recorded Sayings of Ancient Worthies (續古尊宿語要): inside Wuzu Fayan's explicitly headed hall addresses, Wuzu says that Shakyamuni leaving the city at midnight for the Snow Mountains already exposed no small leak and asks what more he contemplated.
